input.quote: 21.1 Each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed Fees actually paid in the one month preceding the event, without exception.
input.rationale: Section 21.1 caps each Party's aggregate liability at one month of Fees and does so "without exception", which is below the fallback 12-month basis (and below our 6-month walk-away floor) and overrides the Excluded Claims defined in 21.3, leaving indemnification, confidentiality/data-protection, gross negligence and wilful misconduct inside the cap with no super-cap. The single replace to 21.1 sets a mutual twelve (12) months' Fees cap expressly subject to Excluded Claims, which 21.3 defines to include indemnification obligations, breach of confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct, so every fallback element is met in operative language. Preferred is not reached: the cap retains "actually paid" with no USD 1,000,000 floor, and the 21.3 payment carve-out is limited to "undisputed Fees for conforming Services", which under the s.1.5 Fees definition does not exempt Customer's payment obligations generally; these are noted rather than pursued. Favourable retained language in 21.2 (mutual exclusion of indirect damages, direct-damages characterisation) and 21.3 is untouched, and 21.2 already referenced Excluded Claims so no dangling term is created.

proposal.summary: Cap raised to 12 months' Fees and Excluded Claims placed outside the mutual cap
proposal.comment: [Playbook] A one-month cap applied "without exception" sits below our walk-away line and swallows the Excluded Claims defined in 21.3. We have moved the mutual cap to twelve months' Fees and carved Excluded Claims (indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct) out of it.

ops.oldText: 21.1 Each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed Fees actually paid in the one month preceding the event, without exception.
ops.newText: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed Fees actually paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the event.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
